correction_reason: Official UK PRTR determination methods include calculated C, estimated E, measured M and unspecified U. The previous script rejected the generic word estimated and could incorrectly discard valid official PRTR or Pollution Inventory annual release rows.
success_requirements: source is explicitly UK PRTR or Environment Agency Pollution Inventory
target facility or operator identity is present
numeric non-negative release value is explicit
release unit is explicit and is not a concentration rate power or duration unit
calculated estimated measured and unspecified official determination methods are valid
permit limits design values avoided emissions BAT values surrogate levels transfers and non-air media are rejected
missing or below-threshold data remains NO_DATA and is never inferred as zero
accepted output remains a facility air-release value and is never promoted to parcel value without verified geometry
